title: ONR studies of a sixth sense
summary: UAPGerb tells of ONR studies of a sixth sense, about 2011–2012 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Office of Naval Research, United States

tellings.quote: going back to 2011 and 2012 the Navy the ONR specifically office of naval research was publishing studies on a six sense within humans.

plain: A UFO researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, that in 2011 and 2012 the Office of Naval Research, the US Navy's science research office, published studies on a "sixth sense" in humans. He brings it up as a sign that the military has taken unusual human perception seriously.
